name: mobigent-repo
description: Open-source SDK for exposing mobile app intents and capabilities to AI agents.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && node --test --import tsx tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:sdk && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --import tsx tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:gateway: npm run build:sdk && node --test --test-name-pattern="gateway|HTTP|MCP|auth|policy|rate|idempot|audit|metric|CORS|manifest|agent profile|tool call|tool list" --import tsx tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:providers: npm run build:sdk && node --test --test-name-pattern="provider|OpenAI|Anthropic|Gemini|retry|adapter" --import tsx tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:app-dx: npm run build:sdk && node --test --test-name-pattern="app and backend|existing app|simple|DX|create-app|starter" --import tsx tests/simple-dx.test.ts
scripts.test:native-protocol: npm run build:sdk && node --test --import tsx tests/native-protocol.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run simple-dx:smoke && npm run bin:smoke && npm run rn-cli:smoke && npm run create-app:smoke && npm run create-app:runtime && npm run pack:check && npm run packed-install:smoke && npm run npm:preflight && npm run docs:build
scripts.verify:ios: swift test --package-path packages/ios && swift build --package-path examples/ios-expense
scripts.verify:android: command -v gradle >/dev/null 2>&1 && (gradle -p packages/android test && gradle -p examples/android-expense :app:assembleDebug) || (echo '[verify:android] Gradle not found locally. Android checks run in CI via gradle/actions/setup-gradle. Install: brew install gradle' && exit 0)
